FAQs

Drain clogs are a nuisance for anyone, especially when they keep on happening. Our Fresno plumbers would need to do a video inspection of your pipes to determine the cause of your frequent clogs. It could be tree roots, limescale buildup that narrows the pipes, a flushed toy, old pipes that need to be replaced, or any number of things.

A garbage disposal can get jammed to where the blades won't rotate if you turn it on. The motor can also burn out or something can cause the garbage disposal's safety switch to flip. Make sure no one turns on the wall switch and check for something logged in the blades.

If there's nothing jamming the blades, press the reset switch on the underside of the garbage disposal and then try to turn it on again. It's possible you may need to replace the garbage disposal.

This depends on your home, who lives there, whether you have pets, and what the outdoor air quality is like where you live. Most people do well to get duct cleaning service every couple of years though some will need it less often and some more. How often do you have to dust? If very often, you may need more frequent duct cleaning service than others.

Low water pressure can be caused by a number of things. It could be that the water supply lines are partially closed, the shut-off valve is malfunctioning, there's a crimped water line, or sediments are building up inside the pipe and causing them to narrow. Our skilled Fresno plumbers would need to inspect and evaluate the problem.
